questions.question: By how many points did the TAIEX increase on that Friday?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the index rocketed 3,186.45 points, its biggest single‑day gain.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明指數上漲了 3,186.45 點，為史上最大單日漲幅。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX surges a record 3,186 points to reclaim 43,000

questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "price targets" mean?
options: The exact price a company will charge for its products
The cost of producing each semiconductor chip
The future stock price that analysts expect the company to reach
The amount of money a company plans to invest in research
questions.explain_en: A "price target" is the stock price analysts predict a company will achieve in the future.
questions.explain_zh: 「price target」指的是分析師預測公司未來的股價目標。
questions.news_title_en: AI wave drives fresh TSMC target-price upgrades

questions.question: According to the summary, why have fund inflows increased for mature‑process and packaging/testing companies?
options: Because they lowered their product prices
Because demand for AI servers and expectations for AI‑chip packaging capacity have become clearer
Because they announced new AI chip designs
questions.explain_en: The summary says fund inflows grew as second‑half demand and AI‑chip packaging capacity expectations firm up.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要指出，隨著下半年需求與 AI 晶片封裝產能預期趨於明朗，資金流入成熟製程與封測公司增加。
questions.news_title_en: AI wave drives fresh TSMC target-price upgrades

questions.question: In the text, what does the phrase "freeing up capital" mean?
options: Making more capital available for lending and other uses
Increasing the amount of money a bank must keep in reserve
Reducing the amount of money a bank has to hold as reserve
Eliminating the need for any capital altogether
questions.explain_en: "Freeing up capital" means the bank can use more of its capital for lending or other activities instead of keeping it locked in reserves.
questions.explain_zh: 「freeing up capital」指的是讓銀行可以把更多資本用於放款或其他用途，而不是被鎖在準備金裡。
questions.news_title_en: Seven banks cleared to adopt internal ratings-based capital method from August

questions.question: When will the seven banks be allowed to use the internal ratings-based (IRB) approach?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that the banks can start using the IRB approach from August.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明這七家銀行將從八月開始使用 IRB 方法。
questions.news_title_en: Seven banks cleared to adopt internal ratings-based capital method from August

questions.question: In the text, what does the phrase "integrated advisory" mean?
options: A type of insurance product for high‑net‑worth clients
A single, combined service that gives overall financial advice
A software tool for trading stocks
questions.explain_en: "Integrated advisory" refers to a comprehensive service that provides overall financial advice, not just separate products.
questions.explain_zh: 「integrated advisory」指的是提供整體理財建議的綜合服務，而不是單一的產品。
questions.news_title_en: HNW wealth-management assets approach NT$2.7 trillion

questions.question: By how much did the number of high‑tier clients increase year‑on‑year?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that high‑tier client numbers are up more than 70% year‑on‑year.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明高階客戶數量較去年同期增加了超過 70%。
questions.news_title_en: HNW wealth-management assets approach NT$2.7 trillion

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "exemptions" mean?
options: Amounts that are taxed at a higher rate
Amounts that must be paid immediately
questions.explain_en: "Exemptions" are portions of income or value that are not subject to tax.
questions.explain_zh: 「exemptions」指的是免稅的金額或範圍，這部分不需要繳稅。
questions.news_title_en: 2026 marks a pivotal year for wealth-transfer tax rules

questions.question: What is the current gift‑tax exemption amount in Taiwan?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that the gift‑tax exemption stays at NT$2.44 million.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明，贈與稅免稅額維持在新台幣 2.44 百萬。
questions.news_title_en: 2026 marks a pivotal year for wealth-transfer tax rules

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "underpinning" mean?
options: Supporting or forming the basis of something
questions.explain_en: Here "underpinning" means that strong exports are supporting or forming the basis of the growth upgrade.
questions.explain_zh: 這裡的「underpinning」指的是強勁的出口在支撐或構成成長升級的基礎。
questions.news_title_en: Think tank sharply upgrades Taiwan's 2026 growth outlook

questions.question: Why did Academia Sinica lift its 2026 GDP growth forecast for Taiwan?
options: Because of the removal of Taiwan‑US tariff uncertainty and a global AI‑investment boom
Because household cost‑of‑living pressure decreased dramatically
Because Taiwan stopped exporting advanced chips
Because the think tank changed its research staff
questions.explain_en: The summary states the forecast was raised due to the removal of tariff uncertainty and the global AI‑investment boom.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要說明，預測上調是因為台美關稅不確定性解除以及全球 AI 投資熱潮。
questions.news_title_en: Think tank sharply upgrades Taiwan's 2026 growth outlook
